name: Multiphase Signed Distance Field Interface Extraction
definition: A method to compute the complete set of interfaces between all phases in a multiphase model by evaluating the intersection of all inflated phases, resulting in thin non-manifold surfaces separating pairs of phases and junctions where more than two phases meet.
summary: Multiphase Signed Distance Field Interface Extraction explicitly defines thin, non-manifold boundaries between multiple material phases while preserving 1-Lipschitz continuity for standard ray tracing.
